name: ArcheryFeeHookV2
mechanic: Swaps pay up to 20% unless you present a voucher won in an archery mini-game.
plain: Every swap pays a configurable fee (up to 20%) collected in ETH, unless the swapper presents a short-lived signed voucher earned in an off-chain archery mini-game. The registrar can only ever lower the fee.
rules: Swaps pay the default fee unless a valid game voucher is shown.
The fee can only be ratcheted down, never up.
